lines.text: From the throne upon the sofa,
She surveys the land once more.
Every rug from wall to wall.
Guide us through these peaceful times!
Every tail now wags as one!
Brightest dog in all the land!
When brave Chunk returns with treasure,
For the good and joy of all.
Then perhaps this ball goes free."
Once there stood a mighty ladder,
Built for humans, tall and steep.
The people watched in silent wonder.
Even the Chunk looked up in awe.
She who made the Gremlin spring!
She need never bark or shout.
Just one gentle nudge upon your arm...
